summary: The registrant, COSCIENS Biopharma Inc., filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting is scheduled for June 17, 2026, with a record date of May 18, 2026, and will be held virtually. This is a routine disclosure of meeting logistics and does not involve any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. As a foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K filing of an ordinary meeting notice, which does not meet the criteria for a special situation.
